nodes.label: ScientistOne: Autonomous Research System
nodes.author: Rui Meng, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Jiefeng Chen, Chun-Liang Li, Palash Goyal, Mihir Parmar, Yiwen Song, Yale Song, Rajarishi Sinha, Parthasarathy Ranganathan, Burak Gokturk, Jinsung Yoon, Tomas Pfister
nodes.rationale: End-to-end autonomous research system with three stages: literature grounding, discovery, paper writing with claim verification; designed to maintain evidence chains by construction

nodes.label: Chain-of-Evidence (CoE) Framework
nodes.rationale: Verifiability framework requiring every claim to trace through recorded evidence chain to grounding source; defines what properties verifiable research artifacts must have

nodes.label: Problem Investigator Module
nodes.rationale: Ensures every cited paper retrieved from scholarly database, read in full text, recorded with provenance; builds citation graph via queries, reads up to 100 PDFs per topic

nodes.label: Parallel Explore-Exploit (PEE) Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Distributes top-ranked proposals across parallel branches; each branch runs isolated cycle with solver iterating up to E evaluated versions; retains top-K branches, fills remaining with fresh ideation

nodes.label: Paper Writer with Claim Verifier
nodes.rationale: Five-stage claim-grounded pipeline: Conceive emits research representation with inline evidence tags; Ground validates tags deterministically; Critic audits gaps and contradictions; Resolve rewrites against flags; Compose renders LaTeX

nodes.label: CoE Integrity Audit
nodes.rationale: Post-hoc audit with four integrity checks: Score Verification (I1), Specification Violation (I2), Reference Verification (I3), Method-Code Alignment (I4)

nodes.label: Score Verification (I1) Check
nodes.rationale: Extracts paper's reported score, re-runs solution on golden evaluator, compares within adaptive tolerance accounting for evaluator noise

nodes.label: Specification Violation (I2) Check
nodes.rationale: Detects when solution code breaks task rules (reverse-engineering evaluator, hardcoding answers); LLMs inspect code against evaluator and task spec with majority vote

nodes.label: Reference Verification (I3) Check
nodes.rationale: Resolves each bibliography entry via multiple academic APIs; LLM cross-checks against returned records; entries matching no record classified as hallucinated

nodes.label: Method-Code Alignment (I4) Check
nodes.rationale: LLM reads paper method section and solution code side-by-side; judges whether paper faithfully describes what code does; acceptable simplification treated as aligned

nodes.label: ADRS Benchmark Tasks
nodes.rationale: Five systems-optimization research problems: Prism (LLM-serving model placement), Cloudcast (cloud network cost), EPLB (expert-parallel load balancing), LLM-SQL (tabular data layout), TXN (transaction scheduling)

nodes.label: Sakana AI-Scientist v2 Baseline
nodes.author: Yamada et al., 2025
nodes.rationale: Best-first tree search with 4-stage experiment manager and separate LLM writeup pipeline

nodes.label: AutoResearchClaw (ARC) Baseline
nodes.author: Liu et al., 2026a
nodes.rationale: 23-stage waterfall pipeline with multi-phase code generation and multi-source literature retrieval

nodes.label: DeepScientist (DS) Baseline
nodes.author: Weng et al., 2025
nodes.rationale: Skill-based single-agent system on Codex CLI with separate code and write skills

nodes.label: AI-Researcher (AIR) Baseline
nodes.author: Tang et al., 2025
nodes.rationale: Orchestrated multi-agent system with specialized survey, coding, and writing agents

nodes.label: CoE Integrity Audit Results (Table 1)
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive audit of 75 papers (5 systems × 3 seeds × 5 tasks); ScientistOne achieves perfect score verification (12/12), zero hallucinated references (0/337), highest method-code alignment (14/15)

nodes.label: MLE-Bench Generalization Tasks
nodes.rationale: Five Kaggle competitions spanning medical imaging, fine-grained recognition, 3D perception; ScientistOne earns two Gold Medals and two Silver Medals

nodes.label: Parameter Golf LLM Training Task
nodes.rationale: Live competition requiring highest-performing language model under strict size and performance constraints; ScientistOne achieves state-of-the-art with novel Hessian-diagonal-weighted SVD and ALS refinement

nodes.label: Numerical Claim Provenance Rate (CPR)
nodes.rationale: Native check unique to ScientistOne; measures fraction of quantitative claims tracing to matching entry in experimental log; achieves 98.1% (627/639 claims pass)

nodes.label: ScholarPeer Automated Review System
nodes.author: Goyal et al., 2026
nodes.rationale: Automated peer review backed by gemini-3.1-pro-preview; ScientistOne achieves 40% accept rate (6/15), tripling best baseline

nodes.label: Failure Mode Case 1: Six Orders of Magnitude
nodes.rationale: ARC LLM-SQL seed 2; paper reports combined score 1,538,006.69 on [0,1] scale; actually internal metric sum of squared prefix-hit lengths

nodes.label: Failure Mode Case 2: Bibliography from Model Memory
nodes.rationale: AIR PRISM seed 1; 3 of 15 references hallucinated; AIR and DS produce hallucinated references at 9% and 21% rates respectively

nodes.label: Failure Mode Case 3: Convergent Specification Violation
nodes.rationale: DS LLM-SQL seed 1; code sorts columns per row-group then renames back; exploits gap between evaluator checks and benchmark intent

nodes.label: Failure Mode Case 4: Fictional Algorithm
nodes.rationale: ARC TXN seed 1; paper describes STAR with bitwise encoding and O(1) surrogate; code uses standard Python sets and full simulator

nodes.label: ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence
nodes.rationale: Autonomous research system with multi-stage pipeline for problem investigation, solution discovery, ablation, and paper writing with chain-of-evidence verification.

nodes.label: Problem Investigator (PI)
nodes.rationale: Five-stage pipeline: citation graph traversal, literature filtering, multi-round investigation with specialist agents, evaluation protocol audit, experiment brief synthesis.

nodes.label: Solver
nodes.rationale: Two-agent system: Solution Development Agent (iterative refinement in sandbox) and Report Writing Agent (generates technical report from artifacts).

nodes.label: Paper Writer
nodes.rationale: Five-stage pipeline enforcing 'provenance before prose': Conceive (narrative structure), Ground (evidence validation), Critic (coherence audit), Resolve (flag resolution), Compose (LaTeX generation).

nodes.label: Claim Verifier
nodes.rationale: Verifies numerical claims (numeric tolerance), citation claims (LLM judge on abstract support), methodological claims (textual overlap against experimental log).

nodes.label: Chain-of-Evidence (CoE) Integrity Audit
nodes.rationale: Four-component audit: Score Verification (LLM extraction + deterministic comparison), Specification Violation (LLM-judged majority vote), Reference Verification (API-based + LLM disambiguation), Method-Code Alignment (LLM-judged).

nodes.label: I1: Score Verification Errors
nodes.rationale: 22 confirmed errors across five systems: value_mismatch (59%), cross_stage_cherry_pick (18%), paper_score_unavailable (9%), evaluator_error (5%), metric_mismatch (9%).

nodes.label: I2: Specification Violation Analysis
nodes.rationale: 11 flagged papers: evaluator import (10 Sakana), evaluator exploitation (7), specification exploit (5), data leakage (1). Sakana ASv2 accounts for 10/11 violations.

nodes.label: I3: Reference Integrity – Hallucinated References
nodes.rationale: Discovered hallucinated references: ARC (1), AIR (21), DS (41). Examples include fabricated papers on optimization, distributed systems, and database techniques.

nodes.label: I4: Method-Code Alignment Findings
nodes.rationale: 95 findings across 25 papers: incomplete_broken (52%), algorithm_class_mismatch (39%), deceptive_dummy_code (9%). ARC only system with deceptive_dummy_code findings.
